title: Active Arena : Thrilling Indoor Games in Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Packed with unique experiences you won’t find anywhere else. Try out our skiing simulator, soar in our paragliding simulator, or take your best shot against a robot goalie. And that’s just the start — with many more fun games and challenges to keep you entertained, competing, and moving the whole time. With 75 minutes of unlimited play, it’s perfect for couples, friends, teens, and families looking for a fun and unforgettable outing. The goal at Active Arena is to inspire guests to discover new passions and leave with lasting memories of fun and challenge.
